despues.Fees: Swap fees users pay the protocol on top of the route, counted in the hour the swap was created on the chain it sold from. The protocol started charging swap fees on 2022-04-24, so fees before that date are zero.
despues.Revenue: All swap fees, split between the treasury and THOR stakers and buyback.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: 25% of swap fees, paid to the treasury.
despues.HoldersRevenue: 75% of swap fees, which goes to THOR stakers and THOR buyback.

antes.UserFees: Lido takes no fees from users.
antes.Fees: Staking rewards earned by all ETH staked with Lido: consensus-layer validator rewards plus execution-layer rewards (priority fees and MEV), as booked by each daily oracle report.
antes.Revenue: Lido takes a 10% fee on staking rewards; Revenue is only the DAO-treasury portion of that fee (net of the node-operator share, which is a cost of production booked as SupplySideRevenue). From Lido V2 (first report 2023-05-16) the treasury/operator split is the validator-share-weighted aggregate read from the StakingRouter at the oracle report's block; before V2 the split was a fixed 5%/5%, so half the fee is treasury.
antes.ProtocolRevenue: DAO-treasury portion of the 10% fee, minus the LDO bought back under the LDO Accumulation Program; excludes the node-operator share.
antes.SupplySideRevenue: Staking rewards earned by stETH holders plus the node-operator share of the 10% fee (paid to operators for running validators).
antes.HoldersRevenue: Tracks LIDO bought back by the DAO as part of the LDO Accumulation Program

despues.UserFees: Lido takes no fees from users.
despues.Fees: Staking rewards earned by all ETH staked with Lido: consensus-layer validator rewards plus execution-layer rewards (priority fees and MEV), as booked by each daily oracle report.
despues.Revenue: Lido takes a 10% fee on staking rewards; Revenue is only the DAO-treasury portion of that fee (net of the node-operator share, which is a cost of production booked as SupplySideRevenue). From Lido V2 (first report 2023-05-16) the treasury/operator split is the validator-share-weighted aggregate read from the StakingRouter at the oracle report's block; before V2 the split was a fixed 5%/5%, so half the fee is treasury. Rewards Share payouts to partners and Curated Module tier rebates, which the DAO pays out of its share through the Rewards Share Easy Track, are deducted on the day they are paid.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: DAO-treasury portion of the 10% fee, minus the Rewards Share payouts and Curated Module tier rebates paid from it and the LDO bought back under the LDO Accumulation Program; excludes the node-operator share.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: Staking rewards earned by stETH holders, the node-operator share of the 10% fee (paid to operators for running validators), and the Rewards Share payouts and Curated Module tier rebates the DAO pays out of its share.
despues.HoldersRevenue: Tracks LIDO bought back by the DAO as part of the LDO Accumulation Program
